fix(codeon): drain reconciliation wakeups in bounded batches (#66)

The runtime tick fetched wakeups with
limit.saturating_sub(progressed_count).max(1), where limit is
max_successful_claims (typically 1). A large backlog of stale wakeups for
terminal attempts was therefore consumed one row per tick, stalling new
attempts behind thousands of no-op rows for many minutes.

Fetch a bounded batch of 100 instead; the existing progressed_count >= limit
check still caps actual progression per tick.
